name: freckle
description: Build with Freckle in your coding agent — AI-powered list building, enrichment, lead scoring, and saved Workflows through agent skills and the freckle CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Build prospect lists, enrich leads, and score companies with Freckle.
interface.longDescription: Use Freckle to build company and people lists, enrich lead data, score companies against your ideal customer profile, and run saved Workflows. Review a Workbook design, test a sample, and inspect the credit forecast before approving a full run. This package uses the Freckle CLI and requires a supported local environment, a Freckle account, and credits for paid operations.
defaultPrompt: Use Freckle to build a list of 50 fintech companies that match my ideal customer profile.
Use Freckle to enrich this company-domain CSV and show a sample and credit forecast before the full run.
Use Freckle to summarize my credit usage by Workbook.
